channel.title: Autosport - F1 News
channel.description: The latest Formula 1 news from Autosport

item.title: Verstappen wins chaotic São Paulo Grand Prix from 17th
item.description: Max Verstappen produced a stunning drive in the wet to win the São Paulo Grand Prix from 17th on the grid.

item.title: Norris takes pole as qualifying delayed to Sunday
item.description: Lando Norris secured pole position after qualifying was postponed to Sunday morning due to heavy rain.

item.title: Ferrari closes on McLaren in constructors' battle
item.description: Ferrari has cut the gap to McLaren in the constructors' championship after a strong double points finish.
